One-mindfully is the second HOW skill. Put your attention on this activity and this moment, returning gently when attention moves away.

## One-Mindfully {#one-mindfully}

Do one thing at a time. When you are worrying, worry; when you are planning, plan; when you are listening, listen.
## Source / Printable Copy

[One-Mindfully source page](/resources/mindfulness/mindfulness-one-mindfully-source.pdf)

## Text Version / Adapted Text

One-Mindfully means doing one thing at a time with full attention. When attention divides or wanders, notice it and return to the chosen activity. Simplify the task or the environment when that supports effective focus.
